language.script: Roman Hinglish with natural Hindi-English code mixing
avoid: pure English narration unless explicitly requested

positioning: Evidence-led cinematic explainers that connect science, technology, engineering, economics, history and geopolitics to explain how the modern world works.
audience_bridge: Start with subjects that connect naturally to the existing Engineering Physics audience (semiconductors, energy, space, infrastructure, strategic technology), then gradually test broader country, history and geopolitics stories. Do not abruptly replace the existing physics education identity before audience response is measured.

content_pillars.description: Semiconductors, AI infrastructure, energy, satellites, nuclear technology, strategic resources and the global competition around them.
How countries industrialized, built wealth, developed infrastructure or faced economic constraints.
International relations, conflicts, borders, historical turning points and their documented consequences.
Engineering systems, megaprojects, transport, energy networks, communications and the science behind global change.

longform.cadence: one carefully researched documentary per week

shorts.cadence: three Shorts per week during the pilot
shorts.purpose: standalone insight or teaser that points to the related long-form documentary

editorial_formula: curiosity hook with a real contradiction or question
clear promise to answer one central question
mechanism: how the system actually works
documented turning points and named case studies

pilot.decision_rule: Compare the documentary pilot against the channel's own recent baseline; do not pivot the whole channel based on one video.
